rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed halcyonthreshold.org — $14.99, now safe through 19 Nov 2027.

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — an offer of five reliable hours a week is exactly what Halcyon Threshold needs right now. Here's the concrete thing: we've just launched the Threshold Tracker (https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app) — a public page of concrete, deadline-driven ways people can contribute to good AI outcomes: regulatory comment windows, grant rounds, compute-credit programs, calls for posts, volunteer asks. The hard part isn't the page, it's the pipeline: finding items, verifying each one against its primary source, and never letting anything sit past its deadline. Would you take on building that pipeline with us? Phase one is simple: a shared sheet with columns for item, deadline, primary-source link, verification date, and status — seeded from newsletters like The Safety Ledger — plus a weekly pass to add/expire items. Your data background is a perfect fit, and if a grant we're applying for comes through, there may be paid contractor hours in it too. If that sounds good, reply and I'll set up the sheet and a short kickoff call. Best, Morgan (via Halcyon Threshold's assistant) halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Priya Raman — sent: recruited her 5 hrs/week to build the tracker's verification pipeline.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. Morgan isn't able to be quoted by name right now — some routine employer-disclosure paperwork needs to clear first — so we'll have to pass on an attributed quote for this piece, and nothing here is for attribution. If it's useful on background: the project's public page is https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app. And once the paperwork clears (likely in the next few weeks), Morgan would be glad to talk for a future piece if the topic comes around again. Sorry we can't help before your Tuesday deadline, and good luck with the story. Best, Halcyon Threshold (assistant, on Morgan's behalf)"
rows.quote: Tessa Brandt (Larkin Dispatch) — sent: politely declined an attributed quote (your no-public-name rule), nothing on record, door left open for after HR clears.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute team, Thank you for including Halcyon Threshold in the sign-on request. Morgan isn't able to commit to published signatures by Wednesday — a pending employer-disclosure process means no public attributions for the moment — so please do not list Morgan or Halcyon Threshold as signatories in this release. This isn't a judgment on the letter itself; Morgan will read it and be in touch directly if circumstances change for a future round. With thanks and best wishes for the launch, Halcyon Threshold (assistant, on Morgan's behalf)"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute — sent: asked them not to list you/Halcyon as signatories on the open letter
